issue_request: FHIR-12447 requested that MedicationRequest.intent be included in search criteria so workflow-aware systems could distinguish prescriptions from MAR/instance entries. Jira status is Published with resolution Persuasive, and the recorded motion was to add instance-order to the MedicationRequest intent value set and make intent a search parameter.
initial_application: Jira comments record revision @10662. additional_context: MedicationRequest is active in source/fhir.ini, and the 2021 source rework commit 33b409a4b6d544598262f2f074ebb4b6dc466157 carried the search parameter into source/medicationrequest/bundle-MedicationRequest-search-params.xml. Related issues FHIR-12388 and FHIR-10456 provide the broader workflow/value-set decision context, while FHIR-12446 is a duplicate/background rename issue.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/medicationrequest/bundle-MedicationRequest-search-params.xml already defines MedicationRequest-intent with code intent, type token, and expression MedicationRequest.intent in the active MedicationRequest resource folder.
